move.body:
Dear Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH team,

You have described Hollerau as an important reference customer; it sounds like this new-series project matters to you beyond the immediate order. We recognise the strain our late payments have caused and will ensure payment as agreed. If we pay promptly, how can you reciprocate on price while also reflecting the verified reductions in material and energy costs?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 31.50 per unit (offer:70240-0). Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -8.5% from 2024-11 to 2025-10 (idx:AS-14404@2024-11, idx:AS-14404@2025-10). We have also put our invoice processing in order and will pay reliably on the agreed day.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 28.06 per unit, 14 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.body:
Dear Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH team,

It sounds like straightforward new business is especially valuable to you, given your available capacity and emphasis on keeping things simple. We value your hands-on approach for our new series and recognise that our late payments have strained the relationship; we will ensure payment within the agreed terms. Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 93% of your invoices late, on average 11 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 11 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 27.85 per unit, 14 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
